# Late-Round Flyers for 1 to 3 USD

**Summary.** Spend the last 1 to 3 USD spots on players with a real path to starter minutes and a top 70 ceiling, not on players whose best case is where they are drafted. The best fits are Poeltl, Porter, Murray-Boyles and Porzingis, plus hedge pairs in open role battles (Missi and Queen, Lendeborg and Santos, Gafford and Morez Johnson). Write down each flyer's minutes target before the draft on 2026-10-18, and cut him after the first few weeks if he misses it.

## What earns a last roster spot

With 144 players drafted, our last two or three spots per team go for 1 to 3 USD. Each of those spots should have top 70 upside. A player whose ceiling is his draft slot can be found on waivers. One expert says to use at least three of your last four picks on flyers who could beat their draft spot by 40 to 50 places. In our room that means a player bought around 130 to 144 who could finish near 80 to 100 or better. ([10-01](https://youtu.be/EGdhmUgPAWY?t=1129), [09-23](https://youtu.be/C4vlgpJ62NI?t=2511), [09-07](https://youtu.be/E-KmhvyZ2CU?t=2414), [09-17](https://youtu.be/DubdKKhMWHo?t=1410))

Upside alone is not enough. The flyer needs a realistic path to a role: he starts, could start, or gets about 27 minutes off the bench. If reports say he will not start and his minutes are capped, pass. Ask one question about every name: is he a starter, or could he become one? ([10-01](https://youtu.be/aLP080hxizA?t=1390), [10-02](https://youtu.be/ZYllcj4o6_A?t=500), [09-24](https://youtu.be/_vbAP5y182A?t=2322), [07-02](https://youtu.be/P6TNP-g0wzY?t=1334))

Price matters. The same player can be a bad buy at 6 USD and a fine swing at 1 USD. Do not push a flyer past 3 USD because another manager bids. Most flyers will not hit, and that is accepted. A failed 1 USD flyer does not hurt the draft, and a hit can win categories for months. ([10-01](https://youtu.be/aLP080hxizA?t=1729), [09-04](https://youtu.be/gerS7ibpaJo?t=479), [10-04](https://youtu.be/tnzmsYUA4yQ?t=1499), [10-04](https://youtu.be/n4KkK-OJjqA?t=1698))

The strongest fits in this pool are Jakob Poeltl, Kevin Porter Jr., Collin Murray-Boyles and Kristaps Porziņģis. Each has a stated top 70 or better ceiling tied to a concrete minutes or health condition. Murray-Boyles may cost 2 to 5 USD because of buzz, so hold your ceiling near the top of that range. ([Jakob Poeltl](../profiles/players/jakob-poeltl.md), [Kevin Porter Jr.](../profiles/players/kevin-porter.md), [Collin Murray-Boyles](../profiles/players/collin-murray-boyles.md), [Kristaps Porziņģis](../profiles/players/kristaps-porzingis.md), [10-01](https://youtu.be/EGdhmUgPAWY?t=1129))

## Disagreement: backups who need an injury

The experts split on handcuffs. One view says a backup who is one injury away from starting is a valid late flyer. The other view says that counting on someone else getting hurt is not a real path, and that those players are poor late picks. For our league, take the stricter line with your final spots. Waivers process daily and allow 6 adds a week, so you can usually grab Paul Reed, Nikola Vučević or Kyle Filipowski the day the starter goes down. The exception is when you already own the starter, as with a Duren owner taking Reed or a Doncic or Reaves owner taking Quentin Grimes. ([10-02](https://youtu.be/ZYllcj4o6_A?t=2512), [10-01](https://youtu.be/aLP080hxizA?t=1390), [09-24](https://youtu.be/_vbAP5y182A?t=2338), [Paul Reed](../profiles/players/paul-reed.md), [Nikola Vučević](../profiles/players/nikola-vucevic.md), [Kyle Filipowski](../profiles/players/kyle-filipowski.md), [Quentin Grimes](../profiles/players/quentin-grimes.md))

## Cheap centers and role battles

A starting center with a useful profile (FG%, blocks, rebounds) is worth a late buy even if the job may not last. The limit is minutes. A late big needs a path to about 30 minutes. If his minutes get split down to about 22, he is useless. That makes Moussa Diabaté, Daniel Gafford, Isaiah Jackson and Khaman Maluach cheap block or FG% sources only while they hold the starting job. ([10-04](https://youtu.be/tnzmsYUA4yQ?t=804), [10-04](https://youtu.be/n4KkK-OJjqA?t=1139), [06-30](https://youtu.be/4GDfg2n2l8o?t=1075), [Moussa Diabaté](../profiles/players/moussa-diabate.md), [Daniel Gafford](../profiles/players/daniel-gafford.md), [Isaiah Jackson](../profiles/players/isaiah-jackson.md), [Khaman Maluach](../profiles/players/khaman-maluach.md))

When two cheap players fight for one job, buy both and cut the loser. Taking two flyers in a similar spot also raises the chance that one hits. This pool has clear pairs. Yves Missi and Derik Queen compete in New Orleans. Yaxel Lendeborg and Gui Santos compete in Golden State. Gafford and Morez Johnson Jr. compete at center in Dallas. Queen will likely cost 3 to 4 USD, so the Missi side of that pair is the cheap one. ([09-10](https://youtu.be/dlo7L8Ru91A?t=1799), [08-24](https://youtu.be/g31YlwRe0XQ?t=2388), [09-07](https://youtu.be/E-KmhvyZ2CU?t=1934), [Yves Missi](../profiles/players/yves-missi.md), [Derik Queen](../profiles/players/derik-queen.md), [Yaxel Lendeborg](../profiles/players/yaxel-lendeborg.md), [Gui Santos](../profiles/players/gui-santos.md), [Morez Johnson Jr.](../profiles/players/morez-johnson.md))

## Young players and rookies

For young flyers, look at opportunity first. One expert leans toward second-year players over third-year players. The data is sobering, though. Sophomores with an ADP of 101 to 150 reach the top 100 only 13% of the time and the top 150 only 33% of the time. Undrafted sophomores almost never matter. Uncertain rookies belong at the end of the active roster or the start of the bench, about picks 120 to 130 in a 12-team league. Darryn Peterson fits that slot at 2 to 5 USD and is not worth more. ([09-07](https://youtu.be/gJUBAJaHzlU?t=481), [09-04](https://youtu.be/gerS7ibpaJo?t=423), [06-25](https://youtu.be/lOshTzDA4SA?t=867), [08-26](https://youtu.be/sTtFUy7IoJI?t=423), [Darryn Peterson](../profiles/players/darryn-peterson.md))

## When to cut

Before you bid, write down the trigger for each flyer: a starting job, a minutes number, or a health check. Late flyers are often drops. You buy them to see what their role turns out to be. Give them a few weeks, then cut anyone who has missed his trigger and use the spot to stream or for a waiver add. ([08-23](https://youtu.be/hm5-fiCa5S4?t=2248), [09-24](https://youtu.be/_vbAP5y182A?t=2517), [09-26](https://youtu.be/3UGI05PDvrE?t=1431), [10-02](https://youtu.be/ZYllcj4o6_A?t=1128))

Some flyers come with a known end date. Lendeborg's value ends when Butler and Moody return. Gafford's early start depends on Lively being out. Isaiah Jackson's likely drop point is Konan Niederhäuser's return. Sell or cut these players before that date instead of after. ([Yaxel Lendeborg](../profiles/players/yaxel-lendeborg.md), [Daniel Gafford](../profiles/players/daniel-gafford.md), [Isaiah Jackson](../profiles/players/isaiah-jackson.md), [Yanic Konan Niederhäuser](../profiles/players/yanic-konan-niederhauser.md))
